name: Sin'dorei Tome of Summoning
summary: The Sin'dorei Tome of Summoning is too powerful to leave in the wilds. You take Rimtori's tome back to Jediga in Valormok.

sections.title: A Tome in the Wilds
sections.body: Rimtori's tome remains on its pedestal, where its pages may hold secrets. Rather than leave such an artifact out here, you carry it back to Jediga in Valormok.

faq.q: What does Jediga want me to bring?
faq.answer: The Sin'dorei Tome of Summoning is the item you bring to Jediga.
Rimtori's tome still sits atop its pedestal in the wilds.

faq.q: Why does Jediga want the tome?
faq.answer: Taking the tome is your own choice, since such an artifact is best not left in the wilds. Jediga sees in it a chance that Belgrom's hunt for riches and revenge was not for naught.
The tome is identified as Rimtori's, but no further details about Rimtori are given.

attribution: In-game quest text: Sin'dorei Tome of Summoning
